loci.rationale: Customer application form renders only email, amount, term, income and the 'auto' route checkbox; no hobby or other purposeless field is offered.
Entrypoint parses the /apply payload into data (bounded field count) and passes it to store.submit; no extra fields are synthesized.
Route /apply forwards the parsed payload to store.submit, the sole collection sink for applications.
Server-side allowlist rejects any key outside {email, amount, term, income, auto}, so a 'hobby' field in the accepted payload is refused.
Schema for cases has no hobby column; only email, amount, term, income, route, stage etc. can be persisted.
Persistence writes only email, amount, term, income, route, stage; summary title derived from amount and term.
Onward payloads limited: offer() sends email/amount/term; portable() sends email/amount/income.
Transfer stores only the portable payload (email, amount, income) for the receiving controller.

output.path_summary: Customer dashboard renders the /apply form with only email, amount, term, income and the auto route checkbox (views.py 31-32). POST /apply is parsed at app.py 53-55 and dispatched to store.submit (app.py 83-84). submit enforces an allowlist {email, amount, term, income, auto} (store.py 67), so a purposeless field such as 'hobby' is rejected; persistence writes only email, amount, term, income, route, stage (store.py 77-79) into a schema without a hobby column (store.py 36-38). Onward sends are limited to email/amount/term (offer, store.py 111-112) and email/amount/income (portable/transfer, store.py 114-116, 201-203). The predicate is satisfied for the named minimization behavior.
